purpose: Define a broader source-universe acquisition plan so User #1 scholarship search does not depend on a tiny hand-picked candidate pie.

lane_reports.name: Legal / paralegal professional bodies

paralegal certification scholarship professional development application

lane_reports.name: Law-firm scholarship programs

lane_reports.name: Southwest Florida local civic and community foundations

lane_reports.name: Certification exam and CLE funding

paralegal certification exam fee scholarship
CLE professional development scholarship paralegal
legal assistant certification grant continuing education
guardrails: Certification eligibility is not scholarship eligibility.

Record exam, dues, and CLE support as different cost categories.

adult learner scholarship directory legal studies
women returning student scholarship database Florida
guardrails: Aggregators do not prove current deadlines.
Aggregator-only candidates cannot become APPLICATION_READY.

required_next_actions: Expand the Opportunity Source Universe before asking for three application-ready scholarships.
Prioritize these lanes first: women-adult-returning-learners, legal-paralegal-professional-bodies, law-firm-scholarship-programs, southwest-florida-local-civic, certification-exam-and-cle-funding.
Harvest sources into a queue first; do not claim applicant eligibility until strict eligibility gate confirms the source.
guardrails: The source universe must expand before the product promises three application-ready scholarships.
A source lane is not an eligibility claim; it is a structured acquisition target.
Aggregator leads expand search surface but cannot prove current applicant eligibility.
Official or sponsor sources remain required before applicant-facing claims.
Strict eligibility gating remains downstream from source expansion and may still return APPLICATION_READY: 0.
Do not store private FAFSA forms, exact income, SSNs, tax records, or full personal statements in the public repository.
